description: Shared governance lifecycle for Articles, Roles, and Decisions. A record is drafted, proposed to the group, and ratified once agreed. Ratified records either close (obligation discharged), are superseded by a successor, or are abandoned (withdrawn without a successor). closed, superseded, and abandoned are final.
name: governance_lifecycle

states.label: Draft

states.description: Put to the group for agreement.
states.label: Proposed

states.description: Agreed by the group and in force.
states.label: Ratified

states.description: Obligation discharged or matter concluded; no successor.
states.label: Closed

states.description: Proposed or ratified record withdrawn without a successor.
states.label: Abandoned
